# Sales  
[⌂ HOME](/d/dpp-home) · **SALES** · CATALOG · ADS · [INVENTORY](/d/dpp-inventory) · FINANCE · TRAJECTORY · [DATA HEALTH](/d/dpp-data-health)  
*Today is compared at the same clock time; current-day Orders data is provisional.*

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(grand_total_amount),0) AS value FROM core.amazon_order o JOIN core.marketplace m USING(marketplace_id) WHERE o.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND (created_time AT TIME ZONE m.timezone)::date=CURRENT_DATE AND fulfillment_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CANCELLED';

SELECT COALESCE(sum(grand_total_amount),0) AS value FROM core.amazon_order o JOIN core.marketplace m USING(marketplace_id) WHERE o.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND (created_time AT TIME ZONE m.timezone)::date=CURRENT_DATE-1 AND (created_time AT TIME ZONE m.timezone)::time <= LOCALTIME AND fulfillment_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CANCELLED';

SELECT COALESCE(sum(grand_total_amount),0) AS value FROM core.amazon_order o JOIN core.marketplace m USING(marketplace_id) WHERE o.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND (created_time AT TIME ZONE m.timezone)::date=CURRENT_DATE-7 AND (created_time AT TIME ZONE m.timezone)::time <= LOCALTIME AND fulfillment_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CANCELLED';
SELECT sales_t7 AS value FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date=CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT sales_t28 AS value FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date=CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT orders_t28 AS value FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date=CURRENT_DATE;

panels.title: Today Pace | Today vs Yesterday vs Same Weekday

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (SELECT generate_series(0,extract(hour from LOCALTIME)::int) hr), d(label,day) AS (VALUES ('Today',CURRENT_DATE),('Yesterday',CURRENT_DATE-1),('Same weekday',CURRENT_DATE-7)), hourly AS (SELECT d.label, extract(hour from (o.created_time AT TIME ZONE m.timezone))::int hr, sum(o.grand_total_amount) sales FROM d JOIN core.amazon_order o ON (o.created_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date=d.day JOIN core.marketplace m ON m.marketplace_id=o.marketplace_id WHERE o.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND o.fulfillment_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY 1,2), grid AS (SELECT d.label,h.hr,COALESCE(hourly.sales,0) sales FROM d CROSS JOIN h LEFT JOIN hourly USING(label,hr)) SELECT CURRENT_DATE::timestamp + make_interval(hours=>hr) AS time, sum(sales) OVER (PARTITION BY label ORDER BY hr) AS value, label AS metric FROM grid ORDER BY time,metric;
SELECT business_date::timestamp AS time,sales AS value FROM mart.business_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-89 ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT s.seller_sku AS "SKU", COALESCE(k.title,'') AS "Product", round(sum(s.sales),0) AS "Sales", sum(s.units) AS "Units", count(DISTINCT s.business_date) FILTER (WHERE s.sales>0) AS "Selling Days", round(sum(s.sales)/NULLIF(sum(s.units),0),0) AS "Avg / Unit" FROM mart.sku_daily s LEFT JOIN core.sku k ON k.sku=s.seller_sku WHERE s.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND s.business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY s.seller_sku,k.title ORDER BY sum(s.sales) DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT to_char(created_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City','MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Time", amazon_order_id AS "Order", fulfillment_status AS "Status", round(grand_total_amount,0) AS "MXN", COALESCE(quantity_fulfilled,0)+COALESCE(quantity_unfulfilled,0) AS "Units" FROM core.amazon_order WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT 30;
